findings.body:
**Update R1 to closed and remove the enforcement claims the test does not implement.**

R1 closed on 2026-10-17. The trusted workflows now run the selfhost entry points:

- `policy/templates/cq-policy.yml:370` runs `trust/dist/selfhost/policy-diff.js`.
- `policy/templates/cq-verify.yml:319` runs `trust/dist/selfhost/recompute-typecheck.js`.

`docs/protected-scope.md:80` and `test/ops/gates/protectedPaths.test.ts:282-283` already state that R1 is closed. Lines 130-153 still describe R1 as open, so the document contradicts itself.

Two enforcement claims do not match the test:

- Lines 173-176: The test pins only the trust-named jobs (`cq-accept`, `cq-policy`, `cq-verify`, `gate`). It does not pin `self-review-loop`, `self-merge-prs`, or `live-drivers`. The test file has no residual list. Adding a privileged executor to those jobs does not fail CI.
- Lines 180-181: The closure walk no longer fails on unprotected files. The advisory posture from 2026-10-20 removed that check. The test now asserts only `src/selfhost/promote-gate.ts`. The walk still fails closed on forms it cannot resolve.

Update the document to match the advisory posture recorded in the test comments and the document summary. Do not restore the removed checks.

<details>
<summary>📝 Proposed doc change</summary>

```diff
-**R1: the CLI dispatch shell in the trusted verifier jobs.** Two trusted
-calls still dispatch through `dist/cli.js`: `cq-policy`'s `gates.policyDiff`,
-and `cq-verify`'s compute job, which runs `ratchet.recomputeTypecheck` to
-produce the typecheck count.
+**R1 (closed 2026-10-17): the CLI dispatch shell in the trusted verifier jobs.**
+The trusted calls now dispatch through `dist/selfhost/policy-diff.js` and
+`dist/selfhost/recompute-typecheck.js`, not `dist/cli.js`.
```

Remove the "**Narrowed in this PR:**" and "**Fix (the next protected batch):**" paragraphs. Their work is complete.

```diff
-`test/ops/gates/protectedPaths.test.ts` pins this table. Every script or
-selfhost entry that a privileged job runs must be protected or appear in its
-residual list, and every listed entry must still be in use. Adding a
-privileged executor therefore fails CI until someone classifies it.
+`test/ops/gates/protectedPaths.test.ts` pins the trusted jobs that name `trust`
+in their commands. The R2 jobs are not pinned, and no residual list exists.
```

```diff
-`test/ops/gates/protectedPaths.test.ts` follows the value-import closure of
-the judging entry points and fails when a file is unprotected. The entry
+`test/ops/gates/protectedPaths.test.ts` follows the value-import closure of
+the judging entry points and fails closed on any form it cannot resolve. The entry
```
